[Read more from the series](https://www.technologyreview.com/tag/tech-review-explains/?utm_source=the_download&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_download.unpaid.engagement&utm_term=*%7CSUBCLASS%7C*&utm_content=*%7CDATE:m-d-Y%7C*).  ### Three things you should know about permafrost ```cpp static double cross(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by, double cx, double cy) { return (bx - ax) * (cy - ay) - (by - ay) * (cx - ax); } bool isEar(uint32_t v) const { const Node &b = _nodes[v]; const Node &a = _nodes[b.prev], &c = _nodes[b.next]; if (cross(a, b, c) <= 0) return false; // turns the wrong way, or not at all for (uint32_t w = c.next; w != b.prev; w = _nodes[w].next) { const Node &p = _nodes[w]; if (cross(a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y, p.x, p.y) < 0 || cross(b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y, p.x, p.y) < 0 || cross(c.x, c.y, a.x, a.y, p.x, p.y) < 0) continue; // outside the triangle if (!samePos(p, a) && !samePos(p, b) && !samePos(p, c)) return false; } return true; } ``` Use a*b[0] < limit and underlined.
